tolerances.justifiedBy: Reuses the 105 per-key bound (absolute + relative × |target|). Speed samples are quantized per 20 Hz frame and the median absorbs free-flow spread; 0.2 m/s covers the posting-limit rounding (0.1 m/s) plus the ±0.04 m/s seeded sample noise, and 5% covers higher urban limits.

Reuses the 105 per-key bound (absolute + relative × |target|). Residential limits are lower, so the same 0.2 m/s posting/quantization floor dominates; the relative part stays at 5% because the estimator uses the same median over a 10 s window.

094 reconstructs the lateral SI candidate with the observed 023 class ceiling, so equal normalized demand on sedan and compact yields candidates with the lateral ceiling ratio (compact/sedan = 1.1538). The 0.25 m/s² floor covers the demand spread and the 20% term covers that documented class reconstruction; it is not a statistical confidence interval.

Reuses the 105 per-key bound (absolute + relative × |target|). An approach window contains deceleration, so the median is a spread statistic rather than a single cruise value; 0.4 m/s covers the approach profile spread and 3% covers faster arterials.

Reuses the 105 per-key bound (absolute + relative × |target|). Demand is a dimensionless p90 fraction mapped to the sedan reference ceiling (6500 N / 1400 kg ≈ 4.643 m/s²); 0.15 m/s² covers the trimmed p50 and the class-capability rounding, 5% covers the demand spread.

Reuses the 105 per-key bound (absolute + relative × |target|). The deceleration ceiling is 8 m/s², so one demand percentage point is 0.08 m/s²; 0.2 m/s² covers the trimmed p50 plus the p90-to-p50 difference and 5% covers stronger braking.

Reuses the 105 per-key bound (absolute + relative × |target|). Jerk is differenced at the fixed 60 Hz tick, so a single-frame acceleration change is amplified; 0.3 m/s³ covers the 1/60 s differencing noise and 10% covers the outer-tail trimming of the p50.

Reuses the 105 per-key bound (absolute + relative × |target|). The reaction is an integer tick count divided by 60, so one tick is 0.0167 s; the 0.02 s absolute floor is exactly that quantization and 2% keeps the bound proportional for longer reactions.

gate.detail: MANUAL observations never update the profile
The segment windows are not eligible for learning

unrepresentable.detail: A passenger modifier needs comparable episodes with and without a passenger; this harness has no passenger context.
An evasive swerve around a hazard is a reactive manoeuvre, not a free-traffic or leader preference; the 24 M targets do not describe it.
Off-road demand is excluded by the eligibility/artefact layers, so it cannot become a style observation.
An external command is not a driver choice, so it is not a learning source even when the raw demand is measurable.

outOfScopeManoeuvre.detail: An evasive swerve around a hazard is a reactive manoeuvre, not a free-traffic or leader preference; the 24 M targets do not describe it.
outOfScopeManoeuvre.description: An out-of-scope evasive swerve around a stopped hazard: the route state is measurable, but no learning key or preference estimate is fabricated for it.
